question.text: Per Section 9.1 of the Series-XIX-B workbook (p. 299), the surcharge applicable to a Trust-structured Cat III AIF on PROFITS AND GAINS FROM BUSINESS OR PROFESSION (i.e., excluding capital gains chargeable under Sections 111A and 112A), where the relevant total income exceeds Rs. 2 crore (individual / HUF / AoP / BoI rules apply), is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.1 (p. 299) of the workbook, surcharge is 25% for Individuals / HUFs / AoPs / BoIs whose total income exceeds Rs. 2 crore. The same page also states that the business / profession income of a Cat III AIF is subject to surcharge over MMR. With the stem now expressly limited to business / profession income (and excluding 111A / 112A capital gains), 25% is the uniquely correct figure. The Trap: Option A (10%) and option B (15%) apply at lower income slabs. Option B (15%) is also the rate the same workbook applies at pp. 315-316 to listed-equity LTCG under Section 112A - which is why the stem has been narrowed to exclude 111A/112A gains. Option D (37%) was the pre-amendment surcharge for individual income above Rs. 5 crore but has been capped at 25% in the new tax regime. Note: The original stem said "total income > Rs. 2 crore" without excluding capital gains under Sections 111A / 112A, which made 15% potentially defensible for listed-equity LTCG under 112A. The stem now specifies "profits and gains from business or profession" so 25% is uniquely correct. Source: Series-XIX-B AIF (Category III) Distributors-December workbook, p. 299; pp. 315-316.
